## Closed `not_planned` — a stale internal docblock is not a finding

Path: fleet decision — none nameable | 缺项 | none

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T19:41Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, and objectui `origin/main`.

The sentence is out of date. Since objectui#10634, a groupBy-only object-bound chart forwards the groupBy column, not `schema.xAxisKey`. But the site is an internal docblock in `packages/core/src/utils/chart-category-key.ts`. That is not a declared contract a user or a published package reads, so it is outside the three finding classes, and nothing renders or validates wrong. The filing gate sends it to the `## Acceptance notes` of the next PR that touches it, not to a card.

Carrier: the next PR that edits `chart-category-key.ts`, or `ObjectChart.tsx`'s `groupByCategoryKey` block, rewrites the one clause. None is in flight today.

Reopen when the text reaches a published surface (a `.d.ts`, a `.describe()` string, docs or a changeset).
